name: 01-reusable-skill
prompt:
IP Character Bornforthis (HIGHEST PRIORITY — preserve the same identity in BOTH supplied reference images): A youthful adult male, not a child, with a compact roughly 3.5–4-head-tall illustrated body. Large rounded-square paper-white face, broad forehead, rounded cheeks, lower face tapering only slightly. Thick saturated cobalt-blue short spiky hair (#1262D5 with #0D55B2 strokes), irregular upward tufts, much shorter sides, jagged front hairline. Two conspicuous outward-projecting semicircular ears, BOTH visible, each with one C-shaped inner line. Short cobalt-blue eyebrows, small cobalt dot/oval eyes with one curved upper-eyelid stroke, tiny bright-yellow nose dot, two symmetrical round golden-yellow cheek circles (#FCD40B), short cobalt single-line closed smile. No beard, no glasses, no realistic skin or facial modeling, no giant anime eyes. Preserve this identity even when pose and clothes change.
Reference interpretation: BOTH images are identity references ONLY, not clothing or composition references. Do not copy yellow background, sticker border, headphones, blue-yellow jacket, yellow top, white T-shirt with beige baggy trousers, sneakers, camera, bag, notebook, thumbs-up pose or surrounding symbols. No identity accessory is required.
Generate ONE standalone 16:9 horizontal Chinese article illustration. Clean PURE WHITE background, no paper texture, no cream tint, no shadow, no gradient, no noise. Visible natural crayon/marker diagonal hatching in every colored fill, slightly wobbly thick dark-navy outlines. Charming warm picture-book drawing, youthful and quietly humorous, not childish, not a polished mascot, not commercial vector art, no PPT/grid/formal flowchart/app UI. Restrained cobalt, navy, bright yellow, coral/orange and white palette. Subjects occupy 40–60% of canvas with at least 35% pure white empty space. No upper-left headline, no surrounding frame, no logo. Bornforthis must physically perform the central conceptual action.
Theme: save repeated verbal requirements into a reusable Skill. One fresh physical metaphor: paper folding. Bornforthis, in a simple coral-orange work apron over a plain light shirt, straight navy trousers and modest plain shoes, stands at a small minimal work surface. With BOTH hands he is folding one absurdly long, loose ribbon of handwritten requests into a compact accordion-style instruction card. The loose ribbon curls once to the left; the compact card is upright between his hands, with its next fold visibly linked to the loose ribbon. It is clear that the repeated instructions become one saved instruction card through his action. No machine, stamp, funnel, assembly line, extra characters or unrelated props. Quiet concentration; complete body visible and adult proportions. Only three short labels, exactly: '重复交代' near loose ribbon in blue; 'SKILL.md' on the compact card in navy; '下次复用' nearby in red. All other paper marks are abstract short strokes, not illegible text. Preserve ample white space and a warm humorous visual, with all colored areas visibly crayon-hatched. Do not draw a screenshot or a diagram of software.

He actively uses his fingers to peel a small sticky name label reading exactly '阿宁' OFF a large freestanding paper badge labeled exactly '负责人'.
